name: Vane

spine.record: Approved site configuration and anonymous page-load history

description: Cookie-free website visits, sources, campaigns and goals with portable history.

externals.why: The owner's scheduled warehouse export (API-002) to their own Amazon S3 or Cloudflare R2 bucket
data: Event rows without the visitor hash

externals.why: Signed webhooks an owner or administrator adds (API-003) to their own endpoints
Browser push services (MOBILE-001) that deliver alerts to the browsers where a signed-in person turned them on
data: Encrypted alert title, site name and app link

externals.why: Owner-initiated read-only Matomo Reporting API history import (IMPORT-005)
data: Selected source site ID and day; one-use API token
Aggregate traffic, goal and ecommerce reports; no visitor logs

externals.why: Owner-approved read-only Google Search Console OAuth (SEARCH-001)
data: OAuth code and read-only credentials at fixed official Google endpoints
Selected property and source date range; aggregate search query/page figures returned; no Vane visitor rows sent

externals.why: Owner-connected read-only Bing Webmaster Tools query/page aggregates (SEARCH-002)
data: Owner-generated API key and verified property sent only to the fixed official Bing API
Source aggregate query, page and date figures returned; no collected Vane visits sent

externals.why: Owner-approved Slack bot OAuth and aggregate chat reports/alerts (REPORT-002)
data: OAuth code at fixed Slack endpoints; chat:write bot credential
Aggregate figures and private filtered dashboard link; no visitor records

externals.why: Owner-connected Microsoft Teams workflow webhook for aggregate reports/alerts (REPORT-002)
data: Aggregate figures and private filtered dashboard link; no visitor records

externals.why: Owner-connected Nook NOOK-079 scoped integration token for aggregate reports/alerts (REPORT-002)
data: Scoped integration token to the owner-entered HTTPS Nook origin
Aggregate figures and private filtered dashboard link; no visitor records

deploy.notes: Native owner sessions guard /app; unknown paths return real 404s; the development outbox is local-only.
